detail: Bank Al-Maghrib's page on its supervisory bodies states that after Mazars' mandate expired, the firm Deloitte was appointed statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) in 2021 for a six-year non-renewable term; the Cour des Comptes does not audit the accounts itself but receives the financial statements and the statutory auditors' reports.
Article 1(17) of the consolidated ECB Decision 1999/70 names Ernst & Young Baltic AS as the approved external auditor of Eesti Pank for the financial years 2021 to 2025.
source_title: Decision of the European Central Bank of 7 October 1999 on the external auditors of the national central banks (1999/70/EC), consolidated text of 26 October 2021 (EUR-Lex)

source_title: Decision of the European Central Bank of 7 October 1999 on the external auditors of the national central banks (1999/70/EC), consolidated text of 26 October 2021 (EUR-Lex)

detail: Council Decision (EU) 2023/2797 approves Mazars, druzba za revizijo, d.o.o. as the external auditor of Banka Slovenije for the financial years 2024 to 2026; the earlier consolidated ECB Decision 1999/70 had named PricewaterhouseCoopers for 2021 to 2023.
source_title: Council Decision (EU) 2023/2797 on the external auditors of Banka Slovenije (Official Journal of the European Union, EUR-Lex)

year: 1993 (Bank of Uganda Act, section 43 - standing arrangement; text as in force 31 December 2023)
detail: Section 43 of the Bank of Uganda Act provides that the accounts of the Bank shall be audited at least once every financial year by the Auditor General, or by an auditor appointed by him or her to act on his or her behalf.
source_title: Bank of Uganda Act (Statute 5 of 1993), text as at 31 December 2023 (Uganda Legal Information Institute)

year: 2006 (Bank of Tanzania Act 2006, section 20(6) - standing arrangement)
detail: Section 20(6) of the Bank of Tanzania Act 2006 states that the annual external audit of the Bank shall be performed by the Controller and Auditor General, in accordance with international accounting and audit standards and in compliance with the Public Finance Act.
source_title: Bank of Tanzania Act, 2006 (Bank of Tanzania)
